# Pictures

Put the site's own pictures in this folder. The pages show a marked slot for each picture they need, with its file
name and size, until the picture is here:

| Slot | File | Size |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Main picture for the home page | `hero.jpg` | 1200 × 900 |
| A picture of you or your place | `about.jpg` | 1200 × 800 |

Then import it where the slot is (for example `import hero from '../../assets/hero.jpg'`) and pass it to the slot as
`src`. Use pictures you made or have the right to use. No stock photos, and nothing loaded from other websites.

`public/social-preview.png` (1200 × 630) is the picture shown when the site is shared; `public/favicon.svg` is the
icon in the browser tab. Replace both with your own.

Part of the Dim Factory web starter. MIT License: copy, change and share it freely.
